name: Belt depth (beat-'em-up lanes)
oneLiner: Gives every character in a side-view game a depth z on a walkable floor band, as in classic street brawlers: characters walk left / right and up / down the floor, a jump is drawn as height above the floor while a contact shadow stays on the ground under the feet (narrower and lighter the higher, none over a pit), characters are drawn sorted by their floor contact line (floor + z, never the airborne y) so nearer ones overlap farther ones, and hits or touches connect only between characters within a depth tolerance. Ships the floor band drawing (several palettes, read from the game's tile grid), lane helpers for the player, the autopilot and foes (walk, steer, chase, seeded lanes), and a camera helper that keeps the active band in view. The game keeps its own x / y physics.
fits: side-scrolling brawlers and beat-'em-ups (the genre's own depth model)
platformers and action games that want a shallow walkable band on the ground (dodging by sidestepping, crowds that overlap correctly)
side-view arenas, towns and hubs where characters should pass in front of and behind each other
notFor: top-down or isometric games (they already have depth)
pure 2D platformers whose challenge is exact vertical collision on thin ledges (a band thicker than the ledge looks wrong)
turn-based side-view battles with fixed positions (no free movement in depth)

needs: a fixed step where the player's up / down are read (belt.walk) and foes move (belt.chase), also run by ?t= fast-forward; belt.update() once per step
every damage test (sword, contact, projectiles) extended with belt.inReach(attacker, target)
the level's floor (a tile grid for gridFloors, or floor runs / floorAt)
render: belt.drawFloor(ctx) after the tiles; the character draw loop replaced by belt.render(ctx, items)
spawn / respawn: z on every new character (place, lane)
provides: z per character, clamped to the band; inReach(a, b) with the tolerance; walk / steer / chase / lane helpers
contact shadows on the floor under the feet; depth-sorted drawing with each character shifted by its z
the floor band (top face) on every floor run, palettes meadow / earth / stone / cobble / planks or custom
frameY(camY) for vertical cameras; stats(), lastDrawn(), reachLog() for checks and judges

assets: module/belt-depth.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_BeltDepth): depth state and helpers, reach test, floor runs from a tile grid, floor band textures drawn in code (pixel and smooth), contact shadows, depth-sorted render, camera band helper, counters for judges
no image, font or audio files
